title: Google Places with FlashData
description: Enter the required query input and your own FlashData API key below. Optional settings can be left unchanged. Click Start to run one Google Places request, then open the run’s Dataset for results or OUTPUT for the complete JSON response. FlashData Credits and Apify resource usage are billed separately; no Actor service fee is added.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Enter one Google Places search query, for example: coffee shops in Singapore. One query is sent per run; do not paste a list of queries.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: In your FlashData account dashboard, open API Keys and create or copy a key with Google Places (google_places) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Clicking Start uses your FlashData Credits.

num.title: Requested results
num.description: How many results to request (1–100). Start with 10. The provider may return fewer results; this does not fetch additional pages automatically.
num.sectionDescription: The required inputs above are enough for a first run. Change these settings only when your workflow needs them.

page.title: Search page
page.description: Which results page to fetch (1–100). Keep 1 for the first page. To fetch another page, start a separate run; each run uses Credits.

gl.title: Country code
gl.description: Optional two-letter country code: us (United States), gb (United Kingdom), or sg (Singapore). Leave blank to use the search provider’s behavior.

hl.title: Interface language
hl.description: Optional Google interface language: en (English), de (German), or zh-cn (Simplified Chinese). This does not translate the returned pages. Leave blank for provider behavior.

location.title: Search location
location.description: Optional location to focus the search, for example: Singapore, or New York, New York, United States. Leave blank if no local focus is needed.

tbs.title: Google search filter (tbs)
tbs.description: Optional Google filter string. For time filtering, use qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (past week), or qdr:m (past month). Leave blank for no explicit filter.

autocorrect.title: Autocorrect
autocorrect.description: Enable to allow the search provider to correct spelling. Leave unset to use the provider’s behavior.
